sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Train Battle is a game of strategy and skill. The objective is to place tracks to outmaneuver your opponent, causing their train to explode in a spectacular display of light and sound. But what makes Train Battle so unique is its use of turn-based gameplay, where each player takes individual turns placing tracks. This creates a game of cat and mouse, where each player must carefully consider their next move, taking into account the tracks that have already been placed. The game also features a variety of power-ups and special tracks that can be used to gain an advantage over your opponent.

One of the key components of Train Battle is the track placement system. Tracks can be placed horizontally or vertically, and they can also be used to block your opponent's tracks. The game features a variety of track types, each with its own unique properties and benefits. For example, some tracks may have a higher speed or damage output, while others may be able to block or deflect attacks. Understanding the different track types and how they can be used to your advantage is crucial to success in Train Battle.

Another important aspect of Train Battle is the use of power-ups and special tracks. Power-ups and special tracks can be earned through gameplay or purchased with in-game currency.
